text.title: Normal Mode
text.declared_genre: Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_key: D minor, lifting toward F major in the final hook
text.declared_mood: Witty, anxious, overstimulated, self-mocking → vulnerable, tender, quietly defiant
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar with percussive busker groove; lo-fi hip-hop drums with soft kick, brushed snare, hand taps; warm upright bass; room hiss; small sensory details tucked low in the mix: kettle click, fluorescent buzz, phone vibration, cutlery clink; hard dropouts before punchlines; sparse piano after second hook; final third adds soft harmonies and fuller bass while staying raw
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male close-mic vocal; spoken-word rap verses with conversational pacing, clipped pauses, dry punchline timing, occasional fast overthinking bursts; soft half-sung folk hook; whispered doubles on “normal mode, ” “too much, ” and “let me be”; final hook warmer and more communal
section_names: Intro – spoken | dry, close-mic | sparse guitar
Verse 1 – spoken rap | light guitar groove
Verse 3 – warmer spoken rap | piano enters lightly
Outro – spoken | slight smile | instruments fading
